in_game_description: The Nirai company once specialized in low cost, mass-market productions. Unfortunately, there was an incident in which an entire batch of Laser FX series exploded simultaneously in various locations around the galaxy, due to a date error in the on-board computer software. After the hasty closure of all the Nirai factories in Festus and Dima, no new weapons were manufactured. The lasers of the EX series are a living relic.
mechanics_text: The date error referred to in the description is a reference to the Y2K bug.
This is the only weapon Terrans use.
You start with this when you first go into Var Hastra's hanger, along with a Micro Gun MK I.
version_notes: Starting weapon in the game. Price listed at wiki as Known Price Range.
